firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently filled their car with gas takes the market price die and starts the first round.
officialTieBreak: Choose randomly if the players cannot remember or would prefer a different method.
clarifications: The die holder begins by adjusting oil prices. The die passes to the left at the end of each round.
